title: rubus paniculatus f. tiliaceus
intro: Rubus paniculatus f. tiliaceus, commonly known as the Black Raspberry or Wild Raspberry, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like fever, diarrhea, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rubus paniculatus f. tiliaceus include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
